name: Dracula

provenance.bg.inset: spec: UI 'Background Dark' (secondary panes; = ANSI black)
provenance.bg.surface: spec: UI 'Background Light' / floating interactive elements
provenance.bg.raised: spec: UI 'Background Lighter' (highest neutral UI fill)
provenance.fg.muted: consensus: tie 1/3 each (Textual $foreground-muted = foreground @60%, k9s comment, btop selection); derived: foreground @60% over background is the only candidate >= 4.5:1 (comment is 3.03:1) [blend(foreground, background, 0.6)]
provenance.fg.on-accent: cross-scheme: text on chromatic fills = N1 background
provenance.fg.title: consensus: 2/2 ports (k9s frame.title, btop title)
provenance.border.focus: spec: focus rings = Functional Purple 'or appropriate accent'; Functional colors are UI-only ('Do not use in editor or terminal applications') -> Purple
provenance.accent.secondary: port: Textual accent = pink; spec keyword hue
provenance.selection.fg: spec: Foreground = default text (kitty selection_foreground is #ffffff)
provenance.status.error: spec: UI state Error = Functional Red -> Red (functional colors are not for terminal apps)
provenance.status.warning: spec: UI state Warning = Functional Orange -> Orange
provenance.status.success: spec: UI state Success = Functional Green -> Green
provenance.status.info: spec: UI state Info = Functional Cyan -> Cyan
provenance.link: spec: Functional Cyan = info, links -> Cyan
provenance.keyhint.key: consensus: 2/4 ports (Textual footer key = $accent, k9s frame.menu.keyColor)
provenance.keyhint.desc: consensus: 2/2 ports (Textual footer description, k9s frame.menu.fgColor)

notes: Discrepancy (Current Line): dracula-theme README says #44475a (= Selection), the 2026 spec says Current Line = Comment #6272a4 used as a translucent overlay (opaque fallback #353747). Followed the spec: border.default = current_line #6272a4. k9s skins/dracula.yaml still uses #44475a.
The spec's Functional colors (functional_*) are UI-only: 'Do not use in editor or terminal applications'. They stay in the palette for reference but no token uses them.
ANSI blue (slot 4) is purple #bd93f9; ANSI black (slot 0) = ui_background_dark.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): keyhint.key -> '5' (slot 5 is the closer match to #ff79c6; slot 5 = #ff79c6, 5.97:1) | link -> '6 underline' (slot 4 #bd93f9 is not the #8be9fd hue; slot 6 = #8be9fd, 10.29:1) | diff.changed -> '6' (slot 4 #bd93f9 is not the #8be9fd hue; slot 6 = #8be9fd, 10.29:1)
